projects.name: Internship System
projects.description: A full-stack internship and document management platform designed to streamline student, faculty, adviser, and admin workflows in one system.
features: AI-powered chatbot for student and faculty support
Dynamic dashboards for students, faculty, advisers, and admins
Document upload, review, approval, and audit tracking
E-signature workflow with secure magic links and PDF-based signing
projects.role: Lead UI/UX Designer, Lead Full-Stack Developer, and Lead AI Integration Developer. Designed and implemented the web and mobile experience, built document workflows and dashboards, integrated OpenAI-powered chatbot and insight features, and created the e-signature setup and magic-link signing flow.

projects.name: Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP)
projects.description: A comprehensive ERP system for managing business operations and workflows.
projects.role: Full-Stack Developer and UI/UX Designer. Started the ERP system foundation, designed the system flow and planned the core workflows, created the UI/UX design, built the frontend and backend features, and integrated cloud-backed file handling with role-based access.

projects.name: Gown Rental
projects.description: A simple storefront for browsing formal gowns and showcasing available pieces on a limited budget.
projects.role: UI/UX Designer and Frontend Developer. Started the project, designed the browsing experience, built the responsive storefront, and kept the system lightweight for Vercel hosting within budget.

projects.name: Helpr
projects.description: A user-centered design case study for an on-demand home service app using blockchain technology.
projects.role: Lead UI/UX Designer. Conducted user research, developed wireframes and high-fidelity prototypes, performed usability testing, and co-authored the research paper for the case study.

projects.name: Linkod App
projects.description: An AI-powered mobile platform that connects Filipino households with trusted barangay-verified home service providers.
features: AI-powered ID verification and fraud detection
Multi-level verification for system, barangay, and PWD users
Secure digital payments with GCash and Maya
Ratings and reviews for trust and reliability
projects.role: UI/UX Designer. Conducted user research, designed flows and information architecture, created wireframes and high-fidelity prototypes, and designed an accessible mobile experience for voice-assisted booking and inclusivity.
